comparison.polling: Up to polls status reads; source-byte read and DR write per step; O(n) CPU byte work.
comparison.interrupt: Same per-byte work plus interrupt entry/exit and schedule cost; final TC interrupt distinct; no executed interrupt latency in this campaign.
comparison.dma: Constant setup/stop/status CPU work plus O(n) bus reads/writes; caller memory retained until EN0; line retained until TC. No zero-cost or latency-bound claim.

limits: Emitted section sizes and compiler local frames are observed; local frames are not complete call-chain/interrupt peak stack.
No physical latency, DMA throughput or energy measured.
Different optimization/targets require rebuilding; these are not portable golden costs.
